messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout finished for inference-service:v7.1. Quick-prefill ON for apac-sg1. Canary policy: auto-ramp to 100% started. Dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/rollouts/3162626262 :rocket:
zara: starting post-deploy smoke (apac-sg1) 60 runs. tagging synth probe: synth-heartbeat.
mike: first batch (60): 4 failures (502) spread across two hosts, p95 jumped from 140ms -> 380ms in last 7m. capturing snippets.
eva: paste one sample (trimmed):
```
2026-04-02T03:12:14Z synth-heartbeat apac-sg1 id=q7f status=502 upstream=reset latency=344ms path=/v1/generate
```
mike: service logs no OOMs, but kernel shows repeated RSTs on nic0 for host-sg1-09 and host-sg1-22. infra pinged.
infra-ops: INF-5001 created: intermittent link resets observed on host-sg1-09 & host-sg1-22 between 03:11-03:14. Scheduling maintenance.
zara: proposal: 1) hold ramp for 20m, 2) cordon+drain the two hosts, 3) keep quick-smoke running at 100 runs/minute, 4) if error rate > 1% or sustained p95 > 350ms, pin apac-sg1 traffic to fallback variant v7-quant3 (manual). any objections?
mike: +1 to holding. drifting p95 concern. prepare routing pin doc just in case.
eva: started drain: `infra ctl drain host-sg1-22 --reason "synth-502-cluster"`
infra-ops: drain accepted; autoscaler will rebalance pods; marking hosts in maintenance.
mike: quick-smoke after drain (100 runs) -> 1 failure (502) from host-sg1-09 (already marked), avg latency 180ms, p95 175ms. seems improved post-drain.
zara: good. keep hold for 10 more minutes to watch for recurrence. if we see >1% failures in that window, we'll flip routing to v7-quant3 for apac-sg1 and notify product.
eva: adding a short release-note entry: "Observed transient synth-heartbeat 502s in APAC-SG1; two hosts drained; monitoring. INF-5001 linked."
infra-ops: confirmed NIC firmware update scheduled for host-sg1-09/22. ETA maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC local.
deploy-bot: Canary policy: rollout paused (auto-hold) due to elevated p95 in apac-sg1. Resume scheduled after manual clear. Telemetry snapshot: https://telemetry/internal/archives/3162626262
mike: TL;DR: hold + drain two flaky hosts in apac-sg1, monitor synth-heartbeat; routing fallback (v7-quant3) ready if failure rate breaches threshold.
zara: ack. I will follow up and update release notes and post-deploy checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
